# Adesh Gairola

> Founder of raxIT (AI security · AI agent governance · runtime security on Anthropic Claude). Sydney, Australia. Builder. 15+ years putting security between fast-moving things and things that can't break. Network → Cloud → AI. Ex-AWS Security.

## What I do

- Founder & CTO, raxIT — AI agent governance and runtime security
- Founder & organiser, AI Security Circle Sydney (monthly, practitioners-only)
- Speaker, AI Engineer Melbourne 2026 — talk: "Kill the God Agent" (autonomous-agent threat modeling), June 3–4
- OWASP LLM Top 10 contributor

## Selected work

- AWS ANZ AI Security Consulting Practice — built and operated as a $4M business inside AWS Professional Services. 150+ enterprise pre-sales engagements. Apr 2023 – Dec 2025.
- AWS Threat Composer (AI threat-modeling framework) — co-authored STRIDE + MAESTRO framework adopted by AWS teams 2024–2025. Productised in AWS Threat Composer.
- AWS Control Tower Proactive Controls — led the project to ship native CloudFormation Hooks-based proactive controls deployed across the AWS customer fleet.
- Multi-modal content moderation for ANZ enterprise GenAI — adopted by multiple Tier-1 Australian banks for centralized internal GenAI platforms.
- model-scanner (open source) — Apache 2.0 Claude Code skill. Scans ML model files, scores risk 0–100, maps to OWASP LLM Top 10 and Australian ISM-2072. https://github.com/raxITlabs/skills
- GrayZoneBench (open source) — Apache 2.0 AI safety benchmark for frontier-model gray-zone requests. https://github.com/raxITlabs/GrayZoneBench
- mcp-oauth-sample (open source) — OAuth 2.1 + MCP server reference implementation on Vercel. https://github.com/raxITlabs/mcp-oauth-sample
- DirePhish (open source) — AI-agent red-team simulator that clones your team into agents and runs the breach 100 times under regulatory time-bounds.

## Writing

- [TRUST ME BRO is not a security control](https://raxitlabs.com/blogs/claude-47-five-layers-cyber-blocking) — Claude Opus 4.7 system card threat model. The trust boundary moved inside the model. April 2026.
- [Reflections on Trusting Trust, 42 years later](https://raxitlabs.com/blogs) — axios npm compromise. We've automated the blast radius.
- [Seems Legit](https://raxitlabs.com/blogs) — model-file vulnerability class. vLLM CVSS 10. 83% of HuggingFace models still ship pickle.
- [Why Apple spent millions protecting a tiny green dot](https://raxitlabs.com/blogs) — Memory Integrity Enforcement. Don't make the guard stronger. Put the guard somewhere nobody can enter.

## How I think

- Business first. Security in service of the outcome the business wants.
- First principles. Start from the problem, not the checklist.
- Practitioner-first. 150+ audits. Tools shipped. Regulation translated into code, not slides.
- Pattern recognition. Same problems, different scales. Name the pattern.
- Paranoia as compass. The thing that makes me uncomfortable is usually the thing worth building for.
- Think Big. Small bets are a tax on time.
